title: Bedlam 200SL pack sizes: 15 ml, 50 ml or 100 ml?
description: Choosing a Bedlam 200SL pack for bed bugs, cockroaches and fleas in Kenya? See which size suits one room, a rental or several homes.
answer: Pick the 15 ml pack for one bedroom or a single treatment, and move up to the 50 ml or 100 ml pack when you look after several rooms, a rental or a small block. Bedlam 200SL is sold for bed bugs, cockroaches and fleas, and every pack is mixed with water as its label directs.
intro: Bedlam 200SL is a soluble liquid insecticide, so the pack you buy decides how many rooms you can treat without a second trip to order. Here is how to match the size to your home, and what to do before you spray.

sections.heading: Which Bedlam 200SL size suits a single room?
paragraphs: A tenant with one infested bed, one kitchen corner or a place where a pet sleeps usually needs only the 15 ml pack. It is a small, low-commitment way to start, and it is easy to store afterwards.
Treat every affected room in the same session. If the pests have already reached the next room, one small pack may not stretch far enough, so count your rooms before you choose.

sections.heading: When should I buy the 50 ml or 100 ml pack?
paragraphs: Choose a larger pack when you look after several rooms: a family home with bedrooms and a kitchen, a rented flat between tenants, or a small block where neighbours have the same problem. A bigger bottle also means you are not short if the label allows a repeat treatment.
The 100 ml pack suits landlords and caretakers who treat more than one unit, because the same bottle covers every unit you manage.

sections.heading: What should I do before I spray?
paragraphs: Preparation decides how well any spray works. Then mix exactly as the label says, wear gloves and a mask, and keep people, pets and food out until the spray has dried.
bullets: Wash bedding at a high temperature and dry it well
Vacuum mattresses, carpets and corners, and empty the vacuum outside
Move beds and furniture away from the walls
Cover food, dishes, fish tanks and pet bowls

faq: Does the pack size change how I mix it?
No. The dilution always comes from the manufacturer's label, whatever pack you buy. The size only decides how much product you have.
What do I do with leftover concentrate?
Keep it in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and children. Do not pour leftover mixture into drains, streams or ponds.
Is Bedlam only for bed bugs?
No. It is sold for bed bugs, cockroaches and fleas in Kenyan homes. For fleas, treat your pets with a vet-approved product at the same time.
closing: Ready to choose? See the [[/p/bedlam-200sl-insecticide-15-ml.html|Bedlam 200SL product page]] for every size, or browse [[/c/bed-bug-killers.html|bed bug killers]]. Our [[/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-bed-bugs-kenya.html|bed bug guide]] covers the full step-by-step.

title: Bugnil 20EC for landlords: treating a rental between tenants
description: A practical routine for landlords and agents using Bugnil 20EC bed bug insecticide to treat a rental unit between tenants in Kenya.
answer: Treat the unit in the gap between tenants: clear and clean it, dilute Bugnil 20EC as the label directs, spray every bed bug hiding place, then inspect again. The 25 ml pack is sized for a single treatment, so plan one pack for each unit.
intro: A bed bug complaint after a tenant moves in costs a landlord goodwill and rent. The empty days between tenants are the ideal time to deal with the problem, because the room is clear and nobody needs to sleep there while the spray dries.

sections.heading: Why treat between tenants instead of after a complaint?
paragraphs: Bed bugs travel on luggage, clothes and second-hand furniture, so a previous tenant may leave a few behind without knowing. They can survive a long time without feeding, which means an empty room is not always a clean room.
Treating before the next tenant arrives stops a small problem from becoming a shared one, and it saves you an awkward call in the first week.

sections.heading: What is the routine for an empty unit?
paragraphs: Work in this order and keep the whole job in one visit if you can.
bullets: Remove or inspect any furniture left behind, especially second-hand items
Wash curtains and washable items at a high temperature
Vacuum the mattress, frame, floor and corners, and empty the vacuum outside
Dilute Bugnil exactly as the label directs and spray mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards and cracks
Keep people, pets and food out until the room has dried, then ventilate it

sections.heading: How many packs do I need for several units?
paragraphs: The 25 ml pack is sized for a single treatment, such as one bedroom or bedsitter, so buy one for each unit you plan to treat. Keep a short record of the unit, the date and the product used.
For large buildings, hostels or repeated infestations, consider a licensed pest control operator as well.

faq: Is Bugnil 20EC suitable for rentals?
Yes. It is an emulsifiable concentrate insecticide intended for bed bug control in homes and rentals, and it is mixed with water as the label directs.
Why do bed bugs return after a treatment?
Eggs and hidden survivors can stay in cracks, frames and furniture. Repeat the treatment only if the label advises it, and check second-hand items before they enter the unit.
What should I tell new tenants?
Tell them the early signs: itchy bites, small blood spots on sheets and dark droppings near the bed. Early reports are much easier to treat than a long-running problem.
closing: See the [[/p/bugnil-20ec-insecticide-25-ml.html|Bugnil 20EC product page]] or browse [[/c/bed-bug-killers.html|bed bug killers]]. For the full process, read our [[/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-bed-bugs-kenya.html|bed bug guide]].

title: Dudu-Stop 25EC in hostels and hotels: a room-by-room plan
description: How hostel and hotel managers in Kenya can use Dudu-Stop 25EC against bedbugs and cockroaches, with a simple room-by-room routine and record.
answer: Treat every affected room on the same day, spray cracks, bed frames and corners after diluting Dudu-Stop 25EC as the label directs, and keep a record of rooms and dates. The 100 ml pack gives enough product to handle several rooms.
intro: In a hostel or hotel, one room with bedbugs becomes five rooms very quickly. A planned routine works better than spraying whichever room complains first, and Dudu-Stop 25EC is sold for bedbugs and cockroaches in homes, hostels and hotels.

sections.heading: Why do infestations spread between rooms?
paragraphs: Bedbugs hide in mattress seams, bed frames, headboards and wall cracks, and they move along pipes, walls and luggage. Cockroaches travel through kitchens, bathrooms and drains. If you treat one room and ignore its neighbours, the survivors simply move next door.

sections.heading: How do I run a room-by-room treatment?
paragraphs: Plan the work so affected rooms are treated close together, ideally in one day.
bullets: Strip the beds and wash bedding, curtains and clothing at a high temperature
Vacuum mattresses, floors and corners, and empty the vacuum outside
Move furniture away from the walls so you can reach the hiding places
Cover or remove food, dishes, fish tanks and pet bowls
Dilute the concentrate as the label directs and spray cracks, bed frames, mattress seams, skirting boards and door and window frames
Keep people, pets and food out of the room until it has dried

sections.heading: What records and follow-up should I keep?
paragraphs: Write down each room, the date and the product used, and inspect beds regularly. Act at the first sign of bites or droppings. Repeat the treatment if the label advises it.
For large or repeated infestations, consider a licensed pest control operator alongside your own routine.

faq: Is the 100 ml pack enough for several rooms?
It is intended to give enough product for several rooms, but the number depends on room size and the dilution on the label. Count your rooms before you order.
Can guests stay in a room soon after spraying?
Not until the spray has dried completely and the room has been ventilated. Follow any waiting time printed on the label.
What about cockroaches in the kitchen?
Dudu-Stop is also sold for cockroaches. Spray cracks and corners behind cupboards, but cover or remove food, dishes and cooking surfaces first.
closing: See the [[/p/dudu-stop-25ec-bedbug-cockroach-killer-100-ml.html|Dudu-Stop 25EC product page]] or read our guide to [[/blog/pest-control-products-for-hotels-and-restaurants-kenya.html|pest control for hotels and restaurants]].

title: Lava 100EC: one concentrate for bugs, roaches, flies and ants
description: What Lava 100EC controls, where to spray it in homes, hotels and offices in Kenya, and how to plan a treatment so pests do not simply move.
answer: Lava 100EC is a public health insecticide concentrate sold for bedbugs, cockroaches, houseflies, ants, fleas and other crawling insects. Dilute it as the label directs, spray the places insects hide or walk, and treat a whole building within a short time.
intro: Most buildings do not have just one pest. A hotel kitchen has cockroaches and flies, a bedroom has bedbugs, and the store has ants. A single multi-pest concentrate in a 100 ml pack keeps the buying simple.

sections.heading: Which pests is Lava 100EC sold for?
paragraphs: The product is sold for bedbugs, cockroaches, houseflies, ants, fleas and other crawling insects in homes, hotels and offices.

Each pest has a habit you can use: bedbugs hide in mattress seams, cockroaches in kitchens, drains and cupboards, houseflies around food and waste, ants along food trails, and fleas in bedding, carpets and pet areas.

A concentrate is also easy to store. Because only the amount you need is diluted at one time, the rest of the 100 ml pack stays sealed in its original bottle for the next treatment, which suits offices and small hotels that spray a little at a time.

sections.heading: Where do I spray in a home, hotel or office?
paragraphs: Dilute with water using the amount stated on the label, then focus on the places insects hide or walk.
bullets: Cracks, crevices and skirting boards
Bed frames and mattress seams
The backs of appliances and under sinks
Door and window frames
Bins and drain edges

sections.heading: Why should I treat the whole building at once?
paragraphs: Insects move from treated rooms to untreated ones. In a building with many rooms, plan the treatment so it is finished in a short time, and prioritise kitchens, stores, bathrooms, bedrooms, staff areas and drains.
Work from the cleanest areas towards the dirtiest, so you do not carry pests or residue from one room into another, and spray lightly, wetting the hiding places rather than soaking every surface.
Keep a short record of the dates and areas treated, and consider a licensed pest control operator for large or ongoing problems.

faq: Is Lava 100EC ready to spray?
No. It is a concentrate, so it must be diluted with water in the amount stated on the label before spraying.
What should I do with food and pets?
Cover or remove food, dishes and cooking surfaces, and cover or remove fish tanks and pet bowls. Keep people and pets out until the spray has dried.
Does hygiene still matter?
Yes. Clean first, seal cracks, store food in sealed containers and take out rubbish daily, so insects have less reason to stay.
closing: See the [[/p/lava-100ec-insecticide-100-ml.html|Lava 100EC product page]], browse [[/c/pest-control-fumigation.html|pest control and fumigation]], or read our [[/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-cockroaches-kenya.html|cockroach guide]].

title: Odourless bed bug spray in Kenya: what Promax 20 EC means
description: What an odourless bed bug insecticide like Promax 20 EC does and does not mean, how it is used in bedrooms, and the safety steps to keep.
answer: Odourless means the spray has little smell, which suits bedrooms. It does not mean harmless. Promax 20 EC is a propoxur-based insecticide concentrate, so follow the label for mixing, keep people and pets out until surfaces are dry, and inspect again after about two weeks.
intro: Many Kenyan households avoid sprays because of the smell, especially in bedrooms. An odourless formulation removes that problem, but it is still a pesticide. Here is how to use Promax 20 EC sensibly.

sections.heading: What does odourless actually mean?
paragraphs: It means the product is formulated so that the spray does not leave a strong smell in the room. It does not change how the product works or how carefully you must handle it. Promax 20 EC contains propoxur, a carbamate insecticide, so the same protective steps apply as for any concentrate.
If someone in the home is sensitive to strong smells, an odourless formulation is easier to live with, but it should never be a reason to skip the label, the gloves or the drying time.

sections.heading: Which pests and places is Promax for?
paragraphs: It is sold for bed bugs, called kunguni, and also for cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies. It leaves a residual film on treated surfaces, so pests that crawl across later are still affected.
Spray mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards, cracks, the backs of sockets and furniture joints. Wet the surface lightly and do not soak it.
Bedrooms, hostel rooms, hotel rooms and offices are the usual places, because bed bugs and cockroaches settle wherever people sleep, eat and leave food.

sections.heading: What safety steps should I keep?
paragraphs: Keep children, pets and fish tanks out of the room until the surfaces are dry and the room is ventilated. Wear gloves and wash your hands afterwards. Do not spray food, utensils or bedding you will use before it dries.
bullets: Read the label and confirm the mixing rate on your pack
Strip the bed, wash bedding at a high temperature and vacuum first
Store leftover concentrate sealed, cool, dry and locked away

faq: Can I sleep in the room straight after spraying?
Not until the surfaces are completely dry and the room is ventilated. Follow any waiting time printed on the label.
Does one treatment remove bed bugs?
Eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if you still see bugs.
Which sprayer should I use?
It works with any hand-pump or knapsack sprayer. Choose the size that matches the area, and always confirm the rate on your pack.
closing: See the [[/p/promax-20-ec-odourless-bed-bug-insecticide.html|Promax 20 EC product page]] and our [[/blog/how-to-read-an-insecticide-label-kenya.html|guide to reading an insecticide label]].

title: Aerosol insect killer at home: using Familly spray safely
description: How to use Familly Insect Killer Super Strength aerosol on flying and crawling insects at home in Kenya, with the safety rules for flammable cans.
answer: Familly Insect Killer is a ready-to-use super strength aerosol for flying and crawling insects such as cockroaches, mosquitoes and flies. Cover food, spray corners, cracks and the air as the label directs, keep it away from flames, and ventilate the room afterwards.
intro: An aerosol is the quickest answer when you see a cockroach in the kitchen or mosquitoes in the bedroom. There is no mixing and no sprayer to wash, but a can under pressure needs more care than most people give it.

sections.heading: When is an aerosol the right tool?
paragraphs: An aerosol suits quick treatment as soon as you see the pest, and places where mixing a concentrate is not practical, such as a flat, a bedroom or a kitchen. It is sold as 1 can and works on flying and crawling insects, including cockroaches, mosquitoes and flies.
For a large or long-running infestation, a concentrate or bait is usually a better main treatment, with the aerosol as a back-up.

sections.heading: How do I spray flying and crawling insects?
paragraphs: For flying insects, spray into the air in the room and then close the door and window for a while, as the label directs. For cockroaches, spray along skirting boards, behind appliances and in cracks, taking care not to spray food or cooking surfaces.
Keep food and people away while spraying, and open windows and doors afterwards to let fresh air in.

sections.heading: What are the safety rules for the can?
paragraphs: Aerosol cans are flammable and under pressure.
bullets: Do not spray near flames, cookers, heaters or sparks
Do not puncture or burn the can, even when empty
Do not leave it in direct sunlight or a hot car
Cover or remove food, dishes and baby items, and move pets and birds out
Store upright in a cool, well-ventilated place, away from children

faq: Do I need to mix or dilute it?
No. It is a ready-to-use aerosol, so you spray straight from the can as the label directs.
How can I keep mosquitoes away for longer?
Use nets and window screens, clear stagnant water around the compound, take out rubbish daily and fix leaking taps so insects have fewer places to breed.
Can I spray it on food or cooking surfaces?
No. Cover or remove food and utensils first, and do not spray cooking surfaces.
closing: See the [[/p/familly-insect-killer-super-strength-aerosol-spray.html|Familly Insect Killer product page]] or read our guide to [[/blog/mosquito-control-at-home-kenya.html|mosquito control at home]].

title: Insecticide dust or spray? When Kelvin Dudu Dust fits
description: When a dry insecticide dust such as Kelvin Dudu Dust beats a liquid spray for ants, fleas, bed bugs and poultry houses in Kenya.
answer: Use a dry dust where liquids cannot go or would soak things: wall cracks, ant trails, nest boxes and kennels. Kelvin Dudu Dust is a ready-to-use carbaryl dust sold for ants, fleas, bed bugs, lice, mites and ticks, applied as a thin, even film.
intro: Sprays are the usual choice, but they are not always the right one. A powder can reach a dry wall crack or a poultry nest box that a wet spray would soak or miss. Here is how to decide.

sections.heading: When does a dust work better than a spray?
paragraphs: Dusts stay dry, so they can be placed exactly where pests travel. Ants nest in walls and under paving, fleas hide in floor edges and bedding areas, and poultry houses and kennels have perches, nest boxes and corners where moisture is unwelcome.
Kelvin Dudu Dust needs no mixing, no sprayer and no water, which makes it handy in a small 100 g pack.
A spray can still be the better tool for open surfaces such as skirting boards or door frames. The two methods often work together: dust the cracks and nests, and spray the surfaces pests cross.

sections.heading: How do I apply Kelvin Dudu Dust?
paragraphs: Apply it dry, with no per-litre rate. Use a thin, even film and do not heap it up.
bullets: Ants: along trails, entry points and around the nest, repeating when ants return
Fleas and bed bugs: floor edges, cracks, bed-frame joints, pet bedding areas and carpets
Poultry houses and kennels: litter edges, perches, nest boxes and corners

sections.heading: What safety steps does a dust need?
paragraphs: Avoid breathing the dust, so wear a mask and gloves. Do not dust food, utensils or drinking water, and keep the pack out of reach of children and pets. Wash your hands after use, and read the label before you start.

faq: Do I need water or a sprayer?
No. The dust is applied dry, straight from the pack.
How often should I reapply it?
Reapply when the pests reappear. A thin film is enough, because heaps of powder do not work better.
Can I use it instead of a spray everywhere?
No. Use it where dry placement helps, such as cracks and nest areas, and use a spray or bait where those suit the pest better.
Can I use it in a poultry house?
Kelvin Dudu Dust is handy for poultry houses, kennels and livestock sheds. Dust litter edges, perches, nest boxes and corners lightly, and keep drinking water and feed covered while you work.
closing: See the [[/p/kelvin-dudu-dust-100-g.html|Kelvin Dudu Dust product page]] or compare options in our guide to [[/blog/cockroach-gel-spray-or-powder-kenya.html|gel, spray or powder]].

title: Cockroach gel bait in your kitchen: how Tatua Advion works
description: How to place Tatua Advion cockroach gel bait in kitchens, restaurants and offices in Kenya, and why small dots work better than long lines.
answer: Clean first, then place small dots of Tatua Advion gel in the cracks, crevices and corners where cockroaches hide. Do not spray insecticide on top of the bait, and check after a few days to re-apply where it has been eaten or has dried out.
intro: A gel bait looks very different from a spray, and it works differently too. Tatua Advion is a ready-to-use cockroach gel in a 30 g applicator tube, suited to homes, restaurants, hotels and offices where sprays are awkward.

sections.heading: How does a gel bait differ from a spray?
paragraphs: Cockroaches feed on the gel and return to their hiding places, which helps reach insects that never come out into the open. Because you use only small dots, a gel is neat and precise, and it suits kitchens and food areas.

That is why a gel is popular in restaurants, hotels and offices, where a strong spray smell or wet surfaces would disrupt service. It is also easier to place around hinges and behind equipment, where a sprayer nozzle cannot reach.

sections.heading: Where do I place the gel?
paragraphs: Clean the area first and remove food and crumbs, so the bait is the most attractive thing on offer. Then apply small dots, not long lines.
Look for the signs first: dark droppings in corners, a musty smell behind cupboards and insects that appear when you switch on the light at night. Place gel closest to those areas.
bullets: Near cupboard hinges and along cupboard edges
Behind cookers and other appliances
Under sinks and around drains
Where you see droppings or cockroach activity

sections.heading: What mistakes should I avoid?
paragraphs: Do not spray insecticide on top of the bait, because it can put cockroaches off. Do not leave food out, since it competes with the gel. Check after a few days and re-apply where the bait has been eaten or has dried out.
Place gel only where children and pets cannot reach, and wash your hands afterwards.

faq: Which pack should I choose?
The 30 g tube suits a home kitchen or a small shop. The 4 x 30 g pack suits restaurants, hotels and offices with many areas to treat.
How soon will I see fewer cockroaches?
It depends on the size of the problem and the sources of food, so check regularly, re-apply where needed and keep up good hygiene.
What else should I do?
Seal cracks, fix leaks, store food in closed containers, empty bins daily and wash dishes before night.
closing: See the [[/p/tatua-advion-cockroach-gel-bait-30-g.html|Tatua Advion product page]] or read our [[/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-cockroaches-kenya.html|cockroach guide]].

title: Fly bait for farms and kitchens: choosing an Agita 1GB pack
description: Agita 1GB fly bait comes in 20 g, 100 g and 400 g packs. See which suits a home, a commercial kitchen or a farm in Kenya, and how to place it.
answer: Choose the 20 g pack for a small home or shop, and the 100 g or 400 g pack for larger kitchens, animal sheds and farms with several fly areas. Place Agita 1GB where flies gather, as the label directs, and keep it away from food, children, pets and livestock.
intro: Flies gather in the same few places: waste points, drains, animal sheds and food preparation areas. A fly bait lets you act where they gather, instead of chasing them around a room.

sections.heading: Which Agita 1GB pack size should I choose?
paragraphs: Agita 1GB is sold for farms, homes and commercial kitchens in 20 g, 100 g and 400 g packs. A household or a small shop can start with the 20 g pack. A restaurant kitchen, a dairy or a farm with several sheds is likely to want the 100 g or 400 g pack, so you do not run short in the middle of a season.

sections.heading: Where should I place fly bait?
paragraphs: Read the label first and place the bait where flies gather, such as near bins, drains, waste points and animal sheds, in the way the label directs. Keep it out of reach of children, pets and livestock, and away from food and food preparation surfaces. Check the bait regularly and replace it as the label directs.
Several small placements in the places flies actually use usually do more than one pile in a single spot, so spread the bait across the problem areas as the label allows.

sections.heading: What else keeps flies down?
paragraphs: Bait works better alongside hygiene, because flies stay where food and moisture are easy to find.
bullets: Cover bins and empty them daily
Clean up spills and food waste quickly
Keep floors and drains dry
Use screens on doors and windows

faq: Is fly bait the same as a spray?
No. A bait attracts flies to a placed product, while a spray is applied over surfaces. Many sites use a bait together with good hygiene.
Can I use Agita 1GB in a kitchen?
It is sold for commercial kitchens, but keep it away from food and food preparation surfaces, and follow the label for placement.
How do I store leftover bait?
Keep it in the original, tightly closed pack in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, food, animal feed and children.
Does the pack size change how I use it?
No. Directions always come from the manufacturer's label. The pack size only decides how much bait you have for the number of areas you need to cover.
closing: See the [[/p/agita-1gb-fly-bait-20g.html|Agita 1GB product page]] or browse [[/c/mosquito-fly-control.html|mosquito and fly control]].

title: Sticky fly rolls for kitchens, dairies and shops in Kenya
description: How to use Green Killer sticky fly rolls where spraying is risky: kitchens, dairies, shops and animal sheds, with tips on placing and replacing them.
answer: Hang a Green Killer sticky roll near windows, doors, bins and counters where flies gather, but not directly above open food. Replace it when it is full of flies or dust. The rolls catch flies with no mess, no vapours and no spraying.
intro: Where food is prepared, stored or sold, spraying insecticide can be risky or may not be allowed. Sticky rolls give you another way to control flies without chemicals in the air.

sections.heading: Where do sticky fly rolls work well?
paragraphs: They suit places where food is handled and people are close by: kitchens and food preparation areas, shops, butcheries, dairies and milk collection points, hotels, restaurants and canteens, market stalls, schools and offices. They also work in stables, poultry houses and animal sheds.
A shop owner or caterer who cannot spray near customers can combine rolls with covered bins, clean counters and door screens for steady control.

sections.heading: How do I hang and replace them?
paragraphs: Open a pack, take out a roll and hang it where flies gather, such as near windows, doors, bins, counters and light fittings. Do not hang it directly above open food, and keep it where people will not brush against it.
Replace the roll when it is full of flies or has collected dust. In a bigger room, hang several rolls for stronger coverage.
Check the rolls once a week. A roll that is dusty or full stops catching, so swapping it promptly keeps the trap working.

sections.heading: Why buy a bundle of 20 rolls?
paragraphs: The Green Killer bundle has 5 blister packs of 4 rolls each, 20 rolls in total. That is enough to keep fresh traps in several rooms, or across a whole business, for a long period, and each blister pack keeps the remaining rolls clean and sealed until you need them.

faq: Do the rolls use chemicals or spray?
No. They catch flies on a sticky surface, with no mess, no vapours and no spraying.
Are they safe around children and pets?
Keep them out of reach. The surface is sticky and can stick to skin, hair and clothing, so do not hang a roll where people will touch it.
What else reduces flies?
Keep rubbish bins covered and empty them daily, clean up spills and food waste quickly, fix drains, keep floors dry and use screens on doors and windows.
closing: See the [[/p/green-killer-fly-catch-trap-sticky-rolls-5-packs-20-rolls.html|Green Killer sticky rolls product page]] or browse [[/c/mosquito-fly-control.html|mosquito and fly control]].
